title: fix: move internal Polli and news jobs to GPT-6
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves Polli's default, review/extraction tools, GitHub bot jobs and news text generation to GPT-6: Luna remains Luna; Terra/Sol use Sol. Existing Azure-primary routes are already deployed.
- Prevents the community monitor from making synthetic requests to official Bedrock models; it can still inspect their analytics and probe community models.
- Preserves Fireworks fallback/embeddings, Perplexity search, Google news images and legacy generation. Leaves `polli-harness-pi` unchanged pending Thomas's decision.
- Validation: 17 workflow tests, seven complexity-routing tests and the config test pass; three workflows parse; Python syntax, Biome and `git diff --check` pass.
- Rollout: shared-account backend permissions already permit GPT-6. Polli deploys through `Deploy / Polli` on merge; the monitor refreshes from main. Credential material is unchanged.

gist.headline: Polli gets a new notebook
gist.blurb: Polli’s internal jobs and the news writer now use GPT-6. Luna stays Luna, Terra and Sol use Sol, and the community monitor leaves official Bedrock models alone.
gist.summary: Routed Polli’s default, review and extraction tools, GitHub bot jobs, and news text generation to GPT-6; kept Luna on Luna and Terra/Sol on Sol, while stopping synthetic monitor requests to official Bedrock models.
gist.impact: Internal Polli and news jobs use GPT-6, while the community monitor can still inspect official Bedrock analytics and probe community models.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a bee working at a cozy internal-automation desk, moving small job cards toward a terminal marked GPT-6. A separate monitor shows Bedrock analytics beside a community-model seedling, without a probe aimed at Bedrock.
